partnershipPlan: Prescriber representatives and two patient partners review the alert wording and the harm surveillance list before randomisation.
socialListening: No social media listening; the network's incident reports mentioning alerts from the last two years are read for themes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On a take I see forty alerts before lunch; I stopped reading them months ago.
items.implication: Measure appropriate response, not clicks, and report alert burden.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the moderate ones go quiet, I want to know someone is still looking at the risky pairs.
items.implication: Keep targeted surveillance of high-risk moderate combinations in both arms.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I assumed the computer would stop a doctor giving me two things that clash.
items.implication: Explain in ward notices what the alert system does and does not do.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My mother takes eleven tablets and her kidneys are poor; that is exactly who I worry about.
items.implication: Keep potassium-raising alerts interruptive for reduced kidney function and report results for older adults.

summary: Four composite voices on alert fatigue, safety nets, trust and older patients.
